verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 ships Go, Python, and TypeScript SDKs plus a raw HTTP API authenticated by a team API key, along with a non-interactive `s0` CLI, so agents can programmatically claim sandboxes, run code through REPL/Cmd contexts, and read files and logs. First-party adapters for OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain Deep Agents directly target agent-driven, human-free use. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox deletion/teardown (only pause is evidenced), a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the full end-to-end loop.
